details: No trustworthy LuAG-specific full photoelastic tensor was located in the searched sources. Do not silently substitute YAG values.
simulation_impact: Required only for stress-induced birefringence / depolarization modeling. Scalar dn/dT and surface deformation can still be modeled.
recommended_action: Obtain experimental LuAG p_ij or explicitly run a sensitivity study using a clearly labeled proxy.

details: Room-temperature k versus doping is available; undoped LuAG k(T) is measured mainly up to 300 K.
simulation_impact: Important if disk locally exceeds 300 K.
recommended_action: Use sample-specific measurement or a clearly labeled extrapolation; package helper refuses extrapolation by default.

details: Körner 2012 provides the curves graphically; publisher figure/PDF access and ResearchGate source image were unavailable during the 2026-09-24 retrace attempt.
simulation_impact: Relevant for high-fidelity line-by-line gain simulation.
recommended_action: Current NPZ/CSV export is an engineering reconstruction from published figures and scalar anchors; replace with an independently digitized trace or author arrays when source images are available.

details: Host LuAG Sellmeier is available; a general high-precision n(lambda,cYb) relation was not located.
simulation_impact: Usually secondary for 5-15 at.% Yb but can matter in precision phase models.
recommended_action: Treat host dispersion as baseline and calibrate with measured sample n/ellipsometry when available.

details: Room-temperature LuAG Cij are available; a robust LuAG Cij(T) set over thin-disk operating temperatures was not located.
simulation_impact: Second-order for moderate temperature excursions, more important for large gradients.
recommended_action: Use room-temperature tensor initially; add uncertainty/sensitivity analysis.

details: Brenier reports intrinsic 90% luminescence quantum efficiency at 10 at.% but actual photon escape depends on disk geometry and coating/reabsorption.
simulation_impact: Directly affects the thermal first-law source.
recommended_action: Use effective escaping yield as a measured input; 90% with escape fraction one is an optimistic lower-heat bound.

details: Beil describes dual-band AR/HR and output-coupler data but not a transferable measured coating stack for this geometry.
simulation_impact: Affects pump recycling cavity loss heating dispersion and damage.
recommended_action: Use documented design targets and a bounded output-coupler screen until vendor specifications or coating measurements are supplied.

details: Published C10100 copper properties are used; indium contact and water-side coefficients are representative values rather than measured hardware.
simulation_impact: Controls disk temperature and thermal lens.
recommended_action: Calibrate contact conductance and water transfer from the chosen plate channel flow and bond construction.
